joint_probability_contract.matrix_requirement: symmetric positive semidefinite correlation matrix with diagonal 1
joint_probability_contract.psd_repair: uniformly shrink off-diagonal correlations toward zero until Cholesky succeeds
joint_probability_contract.independence_fallback: only when no modeled relationship is available; never silently replace a known relationship with independence

team_scoring_environment_contract.relationship: historical team points to player offensive TDs

hard_block_rules: sportsbook price, implied probability, line movement, or same-game market data enters correlation estimation
a reported empirical relationship has fewer observations than minimum_pair_observations
joint correlation matrix is asymmetric, has a diagonal other than 1, or cannot be repaired to positive semidefinite
a known modeled relationship is silently treated as independent
Step 3C mutates Step 3B marginal distribution parameters or exact line probabilities
notes: Step 3C models dependence between football outcomes; Step 3B remains authoritative for each individual marginal probability.
Historical correlations are estimated only from football-side game data and shrunk toward zero to reduce small-sample overfitting.
The Gaussian copula combines Step 3B marginal event probabilities with Step 3C dependence without feeding sportsbook prices back into football probability construction.
Team scoring environment may condition player TD probability only from a football-side pregame team scoring projection, never a sportsbook team total.
